description: Compare credit pack prices (extra usage credits sold on top of a subscription, such as ChatGPT credits) across regions, normalised to the price per 100 credits in one currency. Answers questions like "where are ChatGPT credits cheapest?".

channel.description: Sales channel: web (ChatGPT website checkout, ChatGPT only) or app_store (iOS in-app purchase). Defaults to web for ChatGPT and app_store for other products.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for converted reference prices, e.g. USD, CNY, EUR. Defaults to USD for en and CNY for zh.

locale.description: Language for region and plan names: en (default) or zh.

pack.description: all (default), unit for single-credit prices, or a pack quantity such as 1000.

product.description: Product: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity or grok.

region.description: Optional filter by region code or name.

sort.description: price_asc: cheapest per 100 credits first (default); price_desc; region: alphabetical.

name: compare_credits

per100.description: Price per 100 credits converted to the requested currency.

per100Local.description: Price per 100 credits in the local currency.

title: Compare credit pack prices
